detail.longDescription: 🦖 Date.prototype.setHours() ✅ Widely available (from Jul 2015) https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date/setHours The setHours() method of Date instances changes the hours, minutes, seconds, and/or milliseconds for this date according to local time. # webdev # JavaScript
